title: Formulary Benefit: Changes to the Drug List During the Plan Year
content:
**Negative changes.** A negative change during the plan year is a drug moved to NF, excluded, or raised to a higher tier. It is notified to every member who had a paid claim for the drug in the formulary's grandfathering claim lookback before the change. The notice must come at least the formulary's advance-notice period, in calendar days, before the change effective date.

**Grandfathering.** Where the member's Northbridge formulary grandfathers current users, those members keep the drug's prior status through the end of the plan year. Otherwise the change applies to them on its effective date.

**Positive changes.** A lower tier or a newly added drug takes effect on approval without notice, while the formulary provides for immediate positive changes.

**Cycle and sponsor moves.** The drug list changes on the formulary's update cycle. A sponsor's move to a different formulary takes effect at plan year renewal, with a new transition window for affected members.

**Late notices.** Notices are generated from the change schedule. Where a change's notice was not sent on time, the change takes effect for affected members only once the full notice period has run from the date the notice was actually sent.

Each notice is recorded for the member as a formulary change notice. It shows the drug, the kind of change, the new status, the notice date and the change effective date.

## Judgement grid for an affected member

| Paid claim for the drug in the lookback | Formulary grandfathers | Effect on the member |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | notified, and keeps the prior status to plan year end |
| yes | no | notified, and the change applies on its effective date |

## Late-notice example (hypothetical)

A tier increase is scheduled for 1 October on a formulary with a 60-day notice period, so notice was due by 2 August. Suppose the notice is actually sent on 15 August. The full 60 days then run from 15 August, and the change takes effect for affected members on 14 October, which is 60 days after 15 August.
